author: reek
body: Item designer, fully DB-backed. Dimensions are fetched at load over AJAX (/api/d/<table>). The Type dimension is a fixed hierarchy (Blades, Polearms, ... -> items) whose group membership is page layout (index lists) while the item names come from the items table; Rarity pips are colour-coded from the rarities table; modifier pips (Pommel/Guard/Blade, Head/Haft, ...) appear conditionally on the selected item type, each from its own mod table. No compiled-in content.
